column3: NKJV has “among us,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “among you.”
NKJV includes “Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Lord Jesus.”
NKJV ends with “who does all these things,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text continues into verse 18 with “making these things known.”
NKJV has “Known to God from eternity are all His works,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has only “known from of old.”
NKJV has “and the brethren,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “The apostles and the elders, brothers.”
NKJV includes “saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
